versions.subject: Merge PR #5163 from @Neo23x0 - Add/Update Rsync Linux Rules
versions.detection:
selection:
    ParentImage|endswith:
        - '/rsync'
        - '/rsyncd'
    Image|endswith:
        - '/ash'
        - '/bash'
        - '/csh'
        - '/dash'
        - '/ksh'
        - '/sh'
        - '/tcsh'
        - '/zsh'
filter_main_expected:
    CommandLine|contains: ' -e '
condition: selection and not 1 of filter_main_*
versions.spl: ParentImage IN ("*/rsync", "*/rsyncd") Image IN ("*/ash", "*/bash", "*/csh", "*/dash", "*/ksh", "*/sh", "*/tcsh", "*/zsh") NOT CommandLine="* -e *"
